text.p: Morrison Knudsen Corp and Washington Construction Group Inc said Wednesday that they formally merged following a vote of approval by Washington Construction shareholders.
With completion of the merger, Morrison Knudsen said it is essentially debt free, has a net worth of more than $300 million and a commitment for a $200 million line of credit.
Effective Thursday, the common stock of Morrison Knudsen will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol, MK.

Under Morrison Knudsen's plan of reorganization, shareholders of record August 26 receive a warrant package entitling them to buy 2,765,000 shares of new Morrison Knudsen common stock, or about five percent of the stock of the newly merged company, at $12 per share for a term of about six years.
